# Zed (WIP)

```{.json filename="settings.json"}
// Zed settings
//
// Notes:
// - Zed excludes `.git/` from editor be default: https://zed.dev/docs/reference/all-settings?highlight=file%20scan#file-scan-exclusions
{
  // ==========
  // General
  // ----------
  // General Settings
  "when_closing_with_no_tabs": "keep_window_open",
  "on_last_window_closed": "quit_app",

  // Security
  "session": {
    "trust_all_worktrees": true,

    // Workspace Restoration
    "restore_unsaved_buffers": false,
  },
  "restore_on_startup": "launchpad",

  // ==========
  // Appearance
  // ----------
  // Theme
  "theme": "Kanso Zen",
  "icon_theme": "Catppuccin Mocha",

  // Buffer Font
  "buffer_line_height": {
    "custom": 1.45,
  },
  "buffer_font_size": 16,

  // UI Font
  "ui_font_size": 16,

  // Cursor
  "multi_cursor_modifier": "cmd_or_ctrl",

  // Highlighting
  "current_line_highlight": "gutter",

  // ==========
  // Editor
  // ----------
  // Whick-key Menu
  "which_key": {
    "enabled": true,
  },

  // Scrolling
  "autoscroll_on_clicks": true,

  // Signature Help
  "auto_signature_help": true,
  "show_signature_help_after_edits": true,

  // Hover Popover
  "hover_popover_delay": 100,

  // Inlay Hints
  // ...Setup after week 12

  // Miscellaneous
  "extend_comment_on_newline": false,

  // ==========
  // Languages & Tools
  // ----------
  // File Types
  "file_types": {
    "Markdown": ["qmd"],
  },

  // Inline Diagnostics
  // ...Setup after week 12

  // Languages
  "languages": {
    "Python": {
      // Wrapping
      "preferred_line_length": 88,
      "wrap_guides": [88],
    },
    "Markdown": {
      "remove_trailing_whitespace_on_save": true,
      "show_wrap_guides": false,
    },
  },

  // ==============
  // Search & Files
  // --------------
  "search": {
    "center_on_match": true,
  },

  // File Scan
  "restore_on_file_reopen": false,
  "close_on_file_delete": false, // True after Week 12

  // ==========
  // Window & Layout
  // ----------
  // Title Bar
  "title_bar": {
    "show_branch_icon": true,
    "show_menus": false, // personal preference
  },

  // ==========
  // Panels
  // ----------
  // Git Panel
  "git_panel": {
    "tree_view": true,
  },

  // ===============
  // Version Control
  // ---------------
  // Git Panel
  "git": {
    "inline_blame": {
      "show_commit_summary": true,
    },
  },

  // ==========
  // AI
  // ----------
  // General
  "disable_ai": true, // false after week 12
}
```
